description: The figure, labeled as Figure 4, presents two line plots comparing the performance of different models on two datasets, TruthfulQA and BBQ, as a function of the number of demonstrations. The left plot, titled "TruthfulQA," shows the MC1 score on the y-axis against the number of demonstrations on the x-axis, ranging from 0 to 2000. It compares the "Linear SAE" model (solid black line with circles), "LLaMA-2-chat-7B" (dashed pink line), and "ICD" (dotted cyan line). The "Linear SAE" model shows a significant increase in score from approximately 37.5 at 0 demonstrations to over 39 at 2000 demonstrations. The "LLaMA-2-chat-7B" model shows a slight increase from 37.5 to 38.5, while the "ICD" model remains relatively flat at around 38. The right plot, titled "BBQ," shows the accuracy on the y-axis against the number of demonstrations on the x-axis, ranging from 0 to 1500. It compares the "Squared-Exponential" (solid black line with circles), "Tanh" (solid blue line with circles), "ELU" (solid light blue line with circles), and "LLaMA-2-chat-7B" (dashed pink line) models. All models show a slight increase in accuracy from around 50 to 55 as the number of demonstrations increases. The caption indicates that a higher score indicates better performance and that SEA can start to positively improve the baseline with only 25 demonstrations.
